entity.name: Nick (sickn33)
entity.description: Independent maintainer of Agentic Awesome Skills (AAS), an open-source, local-first catalog and toolchain for discovering, selecting, validating, and installing reusable agent skills across AI coding assistants. I coordinate releases, security and provenance review, contributor support, and the public catalog.

projects.name: Agentic Awesome Skills
projects.description: Agentic Awesome Skills is an MIT-licensed open-source toolchain and CC BY 4.0 knowledge library that helps developers discover, evaluate, and install reusable skills for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and related assistants. It provides an npm CLI, local MCP server, browser-local Workbench, plugin bundles, validation and security tooling, and a public catalog of more than 2,097 skills. Created in January 2026, it had 45,719 GitHub stars, 6,687 forks, and 15,900 npm downloads during the measured period from 31 July to 29 August 2026. The project is independently maintained and accepts community contributions.
